title: HB1227 (2024 Regular): prohibit a homeowners' association from placing certain restrictions on firearms or firearm ammunition.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2024-01-31; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/263950.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 263950, BillId 25265))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2024-01-31. Quote is cut after item (2)(b); items (c)-(e) list other lawful discharges and the section defines 'governing document' and 'homeowners' association'. No passage vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section in SDCL ch. 11-5): A homeowner's association may not include or enforce a provision in a governing document that prohibits, restricts, or has the effect of prohibiting or restricting: (1) The lawful possession, transportation, or storage of a firearm, any part of a firearm, or firearm ammunition; or (2) The discharge of a firearm: (a) For defensive purposes, in accordance with §§ 22-18-3.1 to 22-18-4.9, inclusive; (b) To kill any dog found chasing, worrying, injuring, or killing poultry or domestic animals, as permitted by § 40-34-1;
